name: integral-productivity-engineering
description: Engineering practice for Integral Productivity, covering the life of a repo and of a unit of work. Cold-start routes new repos to the right work-type template and scaffolding skill (bootstrap-mcp-server, bootstrap-private-sdk) and checks they classify under devops-excellence's tier/work-type model. Issue-triage assigns state, category and the accountable GlassFrog role (SAE-009); writing-dispatch-prompts defines the contract for handing work to another agent session.
